newsitem.title: UK: Sheffield up after reaching play-off final.
newsitem.headline: Sheffield up after reaching play-off final.

text.p: Shares in Sheffield United Plc jumped on Thursday after the soccer club last night earned a place in the first division play-off final that could see the south Yorkshire club in the lucrative Premier league next season, dealers said.
The shares leapt 8-1/2p to 63-1/2p by 0841 GMT in volume of 181,000 shares.
"If they actually get to the premiership, the shares would go higher still," said one dealer. "But at the moment it is a gamble."
Sheffield will play Crystal Palace at Wembley on May 26 for a place in the premier league after drawing 2-2 against Ipwswich Town last night.
The shares traded as high as 150p on January 16, the day the club was relisted following the reverse takeover by leisurewear company Conrad.
Sheffield's shares traded at their year low of 52p on May 14, just before the club gained its place in the play-off final.
